annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents OneCoin as a route to financial freedom and directs viewers to select a package and make a payment for coin mining. It promotes passive income and percentage bonuses through recommendations and referrals, while using claims of more than 250 millionaires, rapid growth, gold-backing, stability, and a signup link to encourage prompt action. The records do not establish the claims' accuracy, any completed payment, or any resulting loss.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central offer is to purchase a trading package containing tokens that can be exchanged for mining slots, with the package described as including the cost of mining and as a source of profit. That paid-entry-to-mining-income connection makes S04 primary. The promotion also describes binary-leg commissions and matching bonuses across referral generations, supporting S06 as a secondary mechanism.
